# ShortEchoTagCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `ShortEchoTagCanBeUsedInspection`

In templates, a PHP block that only outputs something — `<?php echo $x ?>` —
reads better as the short echo tag `<?= $x ?>`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{2,3,4,5,6} [Before]
<ul>
<li><?php echo $item->name; ?></li>
<li><?php echo strtoupper($code) ?></li>
<li><?PHP echo $first, ' ', $last; ?></li>
<li><?php print $total; ?></li>
<li><?php print($note) ?></li>
<li><?= $already ?></li>
<li><?php echo $a; echo $b; ?></li>
<li><?php /* hint */ echo $c ?></li>
</ul>
```

```php [After fix]
<ul>
<li><?= $item->name ?></li>
<li><?= strtoupper($code) ?></li>
<li><?= $first, ' ', $last ?></li>
<li><?= $total ?></li>
<li><?= ($note) ?></li>
<li><?= $already ?></li>
<li><?php echo $a; echo $b; ?></li>
<li><?php /* hint */ echo $c ?></li>
</ul>
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Use the short echo tag &#39;&lt;?= … ?&gt;&#39; here.</li>
<li>line 3: Use the short echo tag &#39;&lt;?= … ?&gt;&#39; here.</li>
<li>line 4: Use the short echo tag &#39;&lt;?= … ?&gt;&#39; here.</li>
<li>line 5: Use the short echo tag &#39;&lt;?= … ?&gt;&#39; here.</li>
<li>line 6: Use the short echo tag &#39;&lt;?= … ?&gt;&#39; here.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ShortEchoTagCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ShortEchoTagCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection ShortEchoTagCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
